import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'/app/work')

    return run({'version':1,'traces':[t]})['results'][0]
# A: reset stops delivery
r = one([dg(1,[pkt('A',0,[F(type='STREAM',id=0,offset=0,data_hex='61',fin=False)])]),
         dg(2,[pkt('A',1,[F(type='STREAM',id=0,offset=2,data_hex='63',fin=False)])]),
         dg(3,[pkt('A',2,[F(type='RESET_STREAM',id=0,final_size=3)])]),
         dg(4,[pkt('A',3,[F(type='STREAM',id=0,offset=1,data_hex='62',fin=False)])])])

r = one([dg(1,[pkt('A',0,[F(type='STREAM',id=0,offset=5,data_hex='61',fin=False)])]),
